tables:
  - name: orders
    base_table: { database: SALES_DB, schema: PUBLIC, table: FACT_ORDERS }
    measures:
      - name: total_revenue
        expr: SUM(order_amount)
        synonyms: ["sales", "revenue"]
verified_queries:
  - question: "Top 5 products by revenue last quarter?"
    sql: "SELECT product_name, SUM(order_amount) ..."
caption: The LLM maps new questions onto this contract — it doesn't invent SQL from raw table names.
